summary: feat(agent,cli): persist HITL anonymization, sign rollback snapshots, and unify legacy CLI

delivery.outcome: HITL sessions preserve a single AnonymizationContext across turns with fail-closed alias resolution, RollbackSession signs snapshots with HMAC-SHA256/SHA-256 and recovers interrupted journals after crashes, and legacy CLI commands (scan, features, provider) share unified formatting and complete type annotations without changing public options.
nonGoals: Changing public CLI flags or subcommand names of scan, features, llm, providers, or test-llm.
Modifying concurrent ticket-161 or ticket-163 owned paths.

architecture.decision: Attach a persistent AnonymizationContext to HITLSession and thread it optionally through session_handlers while keeping positional compatibility; upgrade RollbackSession to atomic v2 signed snapshots plus pre-execution crash journals while remaining backward-compatible with v1 files; standardize typing and shared output styling in scan_cmd, features_cmd, and provider_cmd.

dataChanges.description: Private rollback snapshot HMAC-SHA256 signature and pre-execution crash journal in ~/.fixos/rollback

validation.evidence: Multi-turn HITL anonymization and fail-closed alias resolution pass all unit and e2e tests.
Snapshot lifecycle, HMAC-SHA256 tamper detection, and crash journal recovery pass integration tests.
Legacy CLI option parity, typing, formatting, and governance checks pass with zero errors.
